definitions.short: to open , i.e. be (causatively, make ) roomy ; usually figuratively (in a mental or moral sense) to be (causatively, make ) simple or (in a sinister way) delude
definitions.usage: allure, deceive, enlarge, entice, flatter, persuade, silly (one).
definitions.full: H6601. pathah [ מָּתָה ] verb be spacious, wide, open (Aramaic מְּתָא be spacious , be spacious, abundant ; compare Arabic , be youthful, in prime of life , young man, one in prime of life (development of various meanings from v not wholly clear, compare Nö ZMG xi (1886), 735 )); — Qal Participle מֹּתֶה Prov 20:19 possibly one open as to lips, but see מָּתָה denominative below Hiph`il Imperfect 3masculine singular jussive לְיֶפֶת א ׳יַפְתְּ Gen 9:27 may God make wide for Japhet (give him an extensive inheritance). — Perfect possibly Prov 24:28 (reading בִּשְׂפָתֶ֑יךָ וְהִפְתִּיתָ , make wide with (open wide) thy lips , for בִּשׂ ׳יַהֲפִתִּיתָ ᵑ0 , so SS; but compare מָּתָה denominative Pi`el ). [ מָּתָה ] verb denominative be simple (Late Hebrew Pi`el entice ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יִפְתֶּה Deut 11:16 ; וַיִּפְתְּ Job 31:27 ; Participle מֹּתֶה 5:2 ; Prov 20:19 ; feminine מּוֺתָה Hosea 7:11 ; — 1 be open-minded (?), simple Job 5:2 ; פוֺתָה יוֺנָה Hosea 7:11 silly dove ; שְׂפָתָיו מֹּתֶה Prov 20:19 one foolish as to his lips (most, openeth wide his lips ). 2 be enticed, deceived Deut 11:16 ; Job 31:27 . Niph`al Perfect 3masculine singular נַפְתָּה Job 31:9 ; Imperfect 1singular וָאֶמָּת Jer 20:7 ; — be deceived 20:7 rather be persuaded, persuade ; with עַל enticed unto Job 31:9 . Piel Perfect 2masculine singular מִּתִּיתָ Prov 24:28 ; suffix מִּתִּיתַנִי Jer 20:7 ; 1 singular מִּתֵּיתִי Ezek 14:9 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יְפַתֶּה Exod 22:15 +, etc.; Imperative מַּתִּי Judg 14:15 ; 16:5 ; Infinitive construct suffix מַּתֹתְךָ 2Sam 3:25 ; Participle suffix מְפַתֶּיהָ (Ges § 93 88) Hosea 2:15 ; — 1 persuade , woman Hosea 2:16 (figurative, ׳י subject), seduce, virgin Exod 22:16 ; entice , husband Judg 14:15 ; 16:5 ; a man to sin Prov 1:10 ; 16:29 . 2 deceive , 2Sam 3:25 ; Prov 24:28 (yet compare√ Hiph`il above); subject ׳י , object prophet, Jer 20:7 ; Ezek 14:9 , compare 1Kin 22:20-21 , 22 2Chr 18:19 ; 18:20 ; 18:21 ; object ׳י , Psa 78:36 . Paul Imperfect 3masculine singular יְפֻתֶּה : 1 be persuaded , Prov 25:15 . 2 be deceived , Jer 20:10 be beguiled ; by ׳י , Ezek 14:9 . פתא (√ of following; ᵑ7 Syriac; Biblical Hebrew פתה (rara)).
